description: This file implements a notification listener service for Android, specifically tailored for the openclaw project. It manages, captures, serializes, and processes notifications on the device, providing functionalities such as notification filtering, action execution, and establishing a communication protocol with external components.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a simplified notification retrieved from the device, including metadata such as package name, title, text, and timestamps.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationSnapshot
classes.description: Summary data class holding a snapshot of current notifications, whether enabled, connected, and the list of notification entries.

classes.name: NotificationActionRequest
classes.description: Defines a request to perform an action on a notification, such as opening, dismissing, or replying.

classes.name: NotificationActionResult
classes.description: Result structure indicating success or failure of executing a notification action.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService
classes.description: Core class extending NotificationListenerService that handles notification events, manages internal state, serializes data, and executes actions, with integration for the openclaw platform.

methods.name: sanitizeNotificationText
methods.description: Sanitizes notification text by trimming and limiting length to prevent excessively long content.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationEntry.toJsonObject
methods.description: Serializes a DeviceNotificationEntry into a JSON object for external communication.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onListenerConnected
methods.description: Handles connection event when the notification listener service connects to the notification system.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationPosted
methods.description: Processes new notifications posted on the device, updating internal store and emitting change events.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of notifications, updating internal store and notifying external components.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.executeActionInternal
methods.description: Executes user-specified actions (open, dismiss, reply) on notifications, with permission checks and error handling.
